boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Otterbein spaces for studying, meeting, viewing art, and low-key recreation, drawn from current university pages.

cards.title: Pause in the Roush Hall lounge
cards.subtitle: Roush Hall, 27 S. Grove St.
cards.notes: Bring a between-class task or meet a classmate here; the university highlights the lounge’s views toward Cowan Hall and Miller Gallery.
cards.short_summary: A named academic-building lounge for a short reset or casual work session.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein identifies a lounge in Roush Hall as a place to relax between classes and describes its views of Cowan Hall and Miller Gallery.
cards.source_title: Top Places to Hang Out on Campus
cards.access_notes: Use respectfully during building hours; access may vary with university operations.

cards.title: Compare the Science Center lounges
cards.subtitle: Shear-McFadden Science Center, 155 W. Main St.
cards.notes: Try a floor lounge for a reading break or a quick group check-in; Otterbein notes that each floor has a lounge with a different feel.
cards.short_summary: Several floor-level lounges provide informal space inside the science building.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein states that the Science Center has a lounge on each floor and describes them as places to relax between classes.
cards.source_title: Top Places to Hang Out on Campus
cards.access_notes: Use during building hours and keep academic spaces available for their intended users.

cards.title: Settle into Courtright’s quiet floor
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library, 138 W. Main St.
cards.notes: Choose the designated quiet floor when you need sustained solo reading or writing; save conversation and group work for other library areas.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet-study floor in Otterbein’s campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein identifies the third floor of Courtright Memorial Library as a designated quiet floor.
cards.source_title: Top Places to Hang Out on Campus
cards.access_notes: Follow current library hours and quiet-floor expectations.

cards.title: Reserve Library 202 for a small group
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library, second floor by the elevator
cards.notes: Request this four-seat room for a focused planning session; it has a round table, glass whiteboard, and TV with HDMI connection.
cards.short_summary: A reservable four-seat study room with whiteboard and display connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein lists Library 202 (Neiswender) as a second-floor conference and study room with four chairs, a glass whiteboard, and HDMI-equipped TV.
cards.access_notes: Reservation requests are reviewed by the library circulation manager and Events and Conferences; allow the stated processing time.

cards.title: Use the sensory-friendly study room
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library, second floor
cards.notes: Reserve this small room when dimmable lighting and self-care collection items would help you focus; it also has a whiteboard and HDMI TV.
cards.short_summary: A reservable sensory-friendly study room designed for a quieter setup.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein describes Library 214A as a sensory-friendly second-floor room with dimmable lighting, self-care items, a whiteboard, and HDMI TV.
cards.access_notes: Reserve ahead through the library’s stated process; availability is subject to approval.

cards.title: Add Becker Gallery to a library visit
cards.subtitle: Courtright Memorial Library, lower level
cards.notes: Pair research time with a look at the library’s lower-level gallery; check campus information for any current display or access details.
cards.short_summary: A small art gallery located inside Courtright Memorial Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein identifies Becker Gallery as a small art gallery on the lower level of Courtright Memorial Library.
cards.source_title: Courtright Memorial Library Celebrates 50th Birthday with New 24-Hour Lockers
cards.access_notes: Check current library access and any exhibition guidance before visiting.

cards.title: See what’s showing at Fisher Gallery
cards.subtitle: Roush Hall
cards.notes: Look for a current public exhibition and any associated workshop or lecture; the university includes Fisher among its campus art galleries.
cards.short_summary: An Otterbein gallery used for a program of public exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein states that Fisher Gallery presents public exhibitions during the year, including work by Otterbein students and other artists.
cards.source_title: Top Places to Hang Out on Campus
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current exhibition and gallery access before making a special trip.

cards.title: Make time for the Frank Museum
cards.subtitle: 39 S. Vine St., Westerville, OH 43081
cards.notes: Use a free moment to view the current exhibition at this named campus museum; verify visiting details directly before you go.
cards.short_summary: Otterbein’s named art museum on the edge of main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein lists The Frank Museum of Art among its campus art spaces and gives its address as 39 S. Vine St.
cards.access_notes: Check the museum’s current exhibition and visitor information before visiting.

cards.title: Meet up in the Campus Center
cards.subtitle: 100 W. Home St., Westerville, OH 43081
cards.notes: Use the Campus Center as a planned meet-up point, then check its current room, dining, and event access through university channels.
cards.short_summary: A central campus destination with dining, bookstore, and gathering functions.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein calls the Campus Center the heart of campus and identifies dining and bookstore functions there.
cards.source_title: Top Places to Hang Out on Campus
cards.access_notes: Campus Center is a university facility; confirm current operating and event access before arrival.

cards.title: Move at Clements Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: 180 Center St., Westerville, OH 43081
cards.notes: Plan an indoor movement break using the cardio room or track, and follow current recreation-facility rules and access requirements.
cards.short_summary: A named campus recreation facility with cardio and indoor-track space.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein identifies Clements Recreation and Fitness Center and describes its cardio room and indoor track.
cards.source_title: Top Places to Hang Out on Campus
cards.access_notes: Recreation access and schedules can change; check current facility requirements before using equipment or the track.
